name: AsterMax Mechanical Qualification
principles: Solver success is necessary but not sufficient for engineering acceptance.
Benchmark equivalence is separate from physical/numerical validity.
Structural solid comparisons should prefer quadratic volume elements.
Geometric scopes must be topology-stable; raw CAD face indices are audit hints, not persistent identity.
Nodal equivalent stress is computed component-first from averaged tensor components.
Global reaction equilibrium is checked when the applied load resultant is known.
Mesh convergence is evaluated on physical observables, not by chasing a benchmark maximum.

postprocess_policy.equivalent_stress: average tensor components to node first, then evaluate von Mises invariant
